activation_site.layer_convention: block L output; equivalent to hidden_states[L+1] except final post-norm ambiguity avoided by hooks

pooling.answer_sensitivity: final-answer span under frozen text semantics; stored-text boundary reconstruction is used when generation-native token IDs are unavailable
pooling.reasoning_sensitivity: reasoning span under frozen text semantics; stored-text boundary reconstruction is used when generation-native token IDs are unavailable; middle layer only

token_provenance.method: token IDs reconstructed deterministically from stored rendered_prompt and completion
token_provenance.reasoning_boundary_method: use frozen segment_response when its strict prefix-token check passes; otherwise use the separately tokenized stored-text prefix through the final </think>, matching the historical worker procedure validated by the five-row reconstruction gate

frozen_boundary_prefix_check_report.note: True means the separately tokenized prefix through the final </think> equals the stored content-ID prefix (exact reconstruction).

reclassification_applied.note: Metadata-only. The seeded-unclosed rows are malformed_reasoning: all-response retained, answer/reasoning pools unavailable. Stored tensors are unchanged; the off-repo meta_part has_answer_pool flags for the listed uids must be regenerated (no forward pass).
